title: The Iron Ledger
author: R. M. Hartwell
blurb: Silas Amberdale, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
